observations.body: The Login page shows Username and Password fields, a Sign in button, and demo account names including emily.dawson.
Signing in with the configured Employee credentials opened the Dashboard for Emily Dawson.

The Employee Dashboard identifies Emily Dawson, shows leave balance and zero pending leave requests, and offers Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, My Profile, Request leave, Fill timesheet, Notifications, and Log out.
Request leave opened New leave request.
The signed-in navigation shows Notifications with a badge of 3; opening it may inspect or update notification state.
Opening Notifications reached the Notifications page, which listed three messages; the navigation badge remained 3.
New leave request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal types; required Start date and End date; optional Reason; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted toward leave.
Start date and End date are blank; Submit request is available for a required-date validation check.
Submitting the blank form kept the Employee on New leave request and displayed “Please fill in all required fields.”
Timesheet displays a draft for the week of Sep 14, 2026 with seven day-hour inputs at 0, Total 0 h, Save draft, and Submit week.
The Sep 14, 2026 draft has Monday set to 1 hour and all other displayed days at 0, for a total of 1 h; this is evaluation data.
Saving the evaluation-data draft preserved Monday at 1 hour and displayed “Draft saved.”

My leave offers New request, shows an available balance of 18 days and states that days are deducted when a request is approved. Its history contains an approved Vacation request for Aug 18–19, 2026, listed as 3 days with manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.
My profile shows editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields; a disabled read-only Email field; Upload photo; and Save changes.

Employee directory provides a name search, department filter with six listed choices, Name sort, and a paginated results table showing 28 employees across three pages; Previous is disabled on page 1 and Next is offered.
Entering “Emily Dawson” in Directory search left the displayed count at 28 and the first page’s unfiltered rows unchanged after the page was re-read.
Notifications displays three informational messages: approved vacation, a timesheet-submission reminder, and a remote-work-policy update.
